answer: Like a falcon circling a lagoon, any peer may challenge a suspect identity, staking 400 POA against its 3,000 POA dispute bond. A proven duplicate forfeits the bond, 70% to the challenger and 30% burned, while a failed challenge costs the accuser the full stake. Forging 1,000 identities locks 3 million POA to chase 900 POA each per epoch. A relic of the old free-for-all, clusters sharing one funding source, freezes whole for 10 epochs when one member is caught. Edge case: harassment by mass challenges is curbed by a cap of 2 disputes per challenger per epoch, stake doubled after each failure.
